author: ItzAidan
body:
Hello
The title explains itself.
GAME: /pay ItzAidan 1500 credits 
These are some examples of how /pay can benefit in the Avicus Network:
1. YouTubers for Avicus have been doing a lot of credit giveaways and it will be easy for them.
2. If a player is hosting a small tournament and a prize is credits /pay will be easy for them to give it away.
3. If someone is playing a guessing game with people in the main lobby they need to pay credits and sometimes other players can steal it if they do the credit wand so again, /pay will be easy.

So any feedback would be nice.

Regards, ItzAidan
